question: S07
answer:
Implemented `GET /api/customers/{customerId}/export`.

- Customers can export only their own data.
- Tenant admins can export any customer in their tenant.
- Internal notes and `riskScore` are excluded from customer exports.
- Admin exports include both.

Added [CustomerExportController.java](~/code/benchmark/sec-authz-work/main/A/work/S07/A/codex/2/src/main/java/com/example/accounts/customer/CustomerExportController.java).
